```{python}
#| label: setup
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from scipy import stats
from specparam import SpectralGroupModel
from plotnine import (
    aes,
    element_text,
    facet_wrap,
    geom_abline,
    geom_hline,
    geom_point,
    geom_text,
    ggplot,
    labs,
    scale_color_cmap,
    theme,
    theme_bw,
)

from pesco import config, store
from pesco.io import load_sources
from pesco.preprocess import compute_psd
from pesco.spectral import specparam2pandas

PROJECT_DIR = Path("/Users/daniel/PhD/spectral-comparison/code/")
DB_PATH = PROJECT_DIR / "data/interim/analysis.duckdb"
DATA_PATH_SOURCES = PROJECT_DIR / "data/Mantini2018"

fig_dir = Path("figures/chapter2/sensitivity")
fig_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

H_FULL = store.params_hash(
    config.SPECPARAM_SETTINGS, config.FREQ_RANGE, config.SELECTED_MODE
)
```

## Knee vs fixed

```{python}
#| label: knee-vs-fixed
con = store.open_db(DB_PATH)
ap = store.load(con, "aperiodic", H_FULL)
con.close()

wide = ap.pivot_table(
    index=["channel", "dataset"], columns="mode", values="exponent"
).reset_index()
wide.columns = ["channel", "dataset", "exp_fixed", "exp_knee"]
knee_freq = ap.loc[ap["mode"] == "knee", ["channel", "dataset", "knee_freq"]]
paired = wide.merge(knee_freq, on=["channel", "dataset"]).dropna(
    subset=["exp_fixed", "exp_knee"]
)
paired["dataset"] = pd.Categorical(paired["dataset"], config.DATASETS, ordered=True)


def corr_table(paired, x, y):
    rows = []
    for ds, g in paired.groupby("dataset", observed=True):
        r, _ = stats.pearsonr(g[x], g[y])
        rho, _ = stats.spearmanr(g[x], g[y])
        rows.append({"dataset": ds, "pearson_r": round(r, 3), "spearman_rho": round(rho, 3)})
    return pd.DataFrame(rows)


kf_corr = corr_table(paired, "exp_fixed", "exp_knee")
ann = kf_corr.assign(
    label=lambda d: "r=" + d["pearson_r"].map("{:.2f}".format)
    + "  ρ=" + d["spearman_rho"].map("{:.2f}".format),
    x=paired.groupby("dataset", observed=True)["exp_fixed"].min().values,
    y=paired.groupby("dataset", observed=True)["exp_knee"].max().values,
)
knee_vs_fixed = (
    ggplot(paired, aes("exp_fixed", "exp_knee"))
    + geom_abline(slope=1, intercept=0, linetype="dashed", color="#999999")
    + geom_point(aes(color="knee_freq"), size=1.4, alpha=0.5, stroke=0)
    + geom_text(ann, aes("x", "y", label="label"), ha="left", va="top", size=9)
    + facet_wrap("dataset", scales="free")
    + scale_color_cmap(cmap_name="viridis", name="knee freq (Hz)")
    + labs(
        x="fixed-model exponent χ",
        y="knee-model exponent χ",
        title="Knee vs fixed aperiodic exponent (per channel)",
    )
    + theme_bw()
    + theme(figure_size=(9, 4.2), plot_title=element_text(size=11))
)
knee_vs_fixed.save(
    fig_dir / "h3_knee_vs_fixed_exponent.pdf", width=9, height=4.2, dpi=150, verbose=False
)
```

## Fitting range

```{python}
#| label: fitting-range
con = store.open_db(DB_PATH)
H_45 = store.find_run(con, label="range_1-45")
full = store.load(con, "aperiodic", H_FULL).query("mode == 'fixed'")
narrow = store.load(con, "aperiodic", H_45).query("mode == 'fixed'")
con.close()

rng = (
    full[["channel", "dataset", "exponent"]].rename(columns={"exponent": "chi_1_80"})
    .merge(
        narrow[["channel", "dataset", "exponent"]].rename(columns={"exponent": "chi_1_45"}),
        on=["channel", "dataset"],
    )
)
rng["delta"] = rng["chi_1_80"] - rng["chi_1_45"]
rng["mean_chi"] = (rng["chi_1_80"] + rng["chi_1_45"]) / 2
rng["dataset"] = pd.Categorical(rng["dataset"], config.DATASETS, ordered=True)

rng_corr = corr_table(rng.rename(columns={"chi_1_45": "x", "chi_1_80": "y"}), "x", "y")
ann_r = rng_corr.assign(
    label=lambda d: "r=" + d["pearson_r"].map("{:.2f}".format)
    + "  ρ=" + d["spearman_rho"].map("{:.2f}".format),
    x=rng.groupby("dataset", observed=True)["chi_1_45"].min().values,
    y=rng.groupby("dataset", observed=True)["chi_1_80"].max().values,
)
range_scatter = (
    ggplot(rng, aes("chi_1_45", "chi_1_80"))
    + geom_abline(slope=1, intercept=0, linetype="dashed", color="#999999")
    + geom_point(size=1.2, alpha=0.4, stroke=0, color="#2C7FB8")
    + geom_text(ann_r, aes("x", "y", label="label"), ha="left", va="top", size=9)
    + facet_wrap("dataset", scales="free")
    + labs(
        x="exponent χ (1-45 Hz)", y="exponent χ (1-80 Hz)",
        title="Fitting-range agreement of the fixed exponent",
    )
    + theme_bw()
    + theme(figure_size=(9, 4.2), plot_title=element_text(size=11))
)
range_ba = (
    ggplot(rng, aes("mean_chi", "delta"))
    + geom_hline(yintercept=0, color="#999999", linetype="dashed")
    + geom_point(size=1.2, alpha=0.4, stroke=0, color="#E8546B")
    + facet_wrap("dataset", scales="free")
    + labs(
        x="mean exponent  (χ₁₋₈₀ + χ₁₋₄₅)/2",
        y="Δχ = χ₁₋₈₀ − χ₁₋₄₅",
        title="Bland-Altman: range effect is a systematic shift",
    )
    + theme_bw()
    + theme(figure_size=(9, 4.2), plot_title=element_text(size=11))
)
range_scatter.save(
    fig_dir / "h3_fitting_range_scatter.pdf", width=9, height=4.2, dpi=150, verbose=False
)
range_ba.save(
    fig_dir / "h3_fitting_range_bland_altman.pdf", width=9, height=4.2, dpi=150, verbose=False
)
```

## IRASA vs specparam

```{python}
#| label: irasa-vs-specparam
from pesco.irasa import irasa2pandas, run_irasa

SPECPARAM_SETTINGS = dict(peak_width_limits=[1, 8], max_n_peaks=8, peak_threshold=3.0)
IRASA_BAND = (2.0, 40.0)  # Nyquist-limited: band_hi * h_max(=2) < fs/2, fs=200

sources_raw, sources_meta = load_sources(DATA_PATH_SOURCES)
hd_data = sources_raw.get_data()
hd_fs = sources_raw.info["sfreq"]
hd_f, hd_psd = compute_psd(hd_data, hd_fs, fmin=0.5, fmax=80.0)
hd_freqs = np.asarray(hd_f, dtype=float)
hd_psd_mat = np.asarray(hd_psd, dtype=float)

irasa_hd = run_irasa(hd_data, fs=int(hd_fs), band=IRASA_BAND)
irasa_hd_ch = (
    irasa2pandas(irasa_hd, fit_func="fixed")
    .drop_duplicates("ID")[["ID", "exponent"]]
    .rename(columns={"exponent": "exponent_irasa"})
)

fg = SpectralGroupModel(**SPECPARAM_SETTINGS, aperiodic_mode="fixed")
fg.fit(hd_freqs, hd_psd_mat, freq_range=list(IRASA_BAND), n_jobs=1)
sp_hd_ch = (
    specparam2pandas(fg)
    .drop_duplicates("ID")[["ID", "exponent"]]
    .rename(columns={"exponent": "exponent_specparam"})
)
exp_cmp = sp_hd_ch.merge(irasa_hd_ch, on="ID")

irasa_fig = (
    ggplot(exp_cmp, aes("exponent_specparam", "exponent_irasa"))
    + geom_abline(slope=1, intercept=0, linetype="dashed", color="red")
    + geom_point(alpha=0.3)
    + labs(
        x="specparam exponent",
        y="IRASA exponent",
        title="HD-EEG aperiodic exponent: specparam vs IRASA (fixed, 2-40 Hz)",
    )
)
irasa_fig.save(
    fig_dir / "hd_exponent_specparam_vs_irasa.pdf", width=6, height=6, dpi=300, verbose=False
)
```
